form.label: Personal SIEM Lab — Authentication Security
form.description: Authentication events from the Flask lab app (index=siem_lab), collected by the Splunk Universal Forwarder.

search.query: index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth | timechart count by result
index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth result=failure | stats count AS failures BY user | sort -failures | head 10

index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth | stats count(eval(result="failure")) AS failure, count(eval(result="success")) AS success BY src_ip | eval total=failure+success | sort -total | head 10 | fields - total

panel.title: DET-01 · Brute force (≥ 5 failures, same IP + user, 5 min)

search.query: index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth result=failure | eval event_time=_time | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS failures, min(event_time) AS first_seen, max(event_time) AS last_seen BY _time, src_ip, user | where failures >= 5 | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table first_seen, last_seen, src_ip, user, failures | sort -failures

panel.title: DET-02 · Password spraying (> 5 users, same IP, 15 min)

search.query: index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth result=failure | eval event_time=_time | bin _time span=15m | stats dc(user) AS distinct_users, count AS failures, min(event_time) AS first_seen BY _time, src_ip | where distinct_users > 5 | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table first_seen, src_ip, distinct_users, failures | sort -distinct_users

index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth | eval event_time=_time | eval fail_time=if(result="failure", event_time, null()), success_time=if(result="success", event_time, null()) | bin _time span=10m | stats count(fail_time) AS failures, count(success_time) AS successes, min(fail_time) AS first_failure, max(success_time) AS compromised_at BY _time, src_ip, user | where failures >= 5 AND successes >= 1 AND compromised_at > first_failure | eval compromised_at=strftime(compromised_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table compromised_at, src_ip, user, failures
index=siem_lab sourcetype=siem_lab:auth result=failure | sort -_time | table _time, src_ip, user, reason, user_agent | head 20
